adc_input.basis: Measured: the twelve key-row values seg5 0xc8ce9c keeps at 0xfdb018, read from a service-mode RAM capture of an X-T20 2.11 with all keys released, assigned to channels 0-11 in order (the xpro-lab emulator model). Channel 3 is the ladder for the 4-way pad, OK, Q and DISP/BACK; channel 2 carries the S1/S2 thresholds 0x28/0x1d0. The channel order and the values of channels 10 and 11 are not confirmed against the converter registers.

gpio_input.basis: Measured: the sixteen GPIO input words X-T20 2.11 stage 2 snapshots into the boot information (+0x00), read from a service-mode RAM capture with lens attached, card inserted and PLAY released, adjusted to a normal power-on without a cable: bank 0 bits 0/1 (S1/S2, released high) are set, since the capture held the shutter for service mode, and bank 1 bit 14 (VBUS, polled by the USB detection) is clear, since the capture was taken over USB; with VBUS high the start mode becomes JIG. Pin roles from seg5 key rows (table 0xec6e10): bank 0 bit 11 LENS_DET and bank 10 bit 4 CARD_DET active low.

loader_handoff.basis: Camera capture: the 0x5c0-byte stage-2 block the kernel copies to 0x7f4fc, read over ff80 in a service-mode power-on (X-T20 2.11, 2026-10-20; SHA-256 d7cca82d81be252c32012d9392b6f9143a5729d52bd04f21c2a90c1c54e54cca). +0x00 holds the 16 power-on GPIO input words, adjusted to a normal power-on without a cable as in gpio_input: bank 0 bits 0/1 (S1/S2) set (captured 0xe4f4, shutter held for service mode) and bank 1 bit 14 (VBUS) clear (captured 0x503c, taken over USB), and +0x140 the sub-CPU power-on cause 0x10, which section 5 decodes as a normal start. Placed in a free RAM gap; kernel entry bypasses the boot ROM and stage 2.

flash_aperture.basis: Declared discovery input: the update image from its flash offset; bytes past it read erased, including the configuration store at flash 0x3840000, which the firmware then rebuilds from its defaults.

nor.basis: Declared discovery input. The X-T20 2.11 driver addresses chip select 0 below aperture 0xf4000000 (0xc505dc) and uses 4 KiB (0x21), 64 KiB (0xdc) erase and 256-byte 4PP (0x12) page programs (command table 0xed3f9c). The chip part, its reset configuration and all latencies are not measured; the ticks are synthetic.

sub_cpu.basis: Declared discovery input. Segment 5 reaches the sub-CPU through 16-bit words on serial port 2 (0xc6fb10, 0xc6fbb4; register table 0xed6a0c): bits 14..8 name the register, bit 15 writes the low byte, and the word read back from +0x60 (0xc4b964) carries the register value. Register 0x60 is the power-on cause; 0x10 is the normal start the camera reported (loader handoff word power_on_cause). Registers 0x50-0x5f hold the 16-byte settings header that 0xcdd670 validates; a selected user profile places its header there (profile_header); otherwise they read zero, so the firmware loads its defaults and writes the stock header back. Unlisted registers read zero; the register file is not measured beyond these reads.
